pulses.name: CVE-2026-33017: How attackers compromised Langflow AI pipelines in 20 hours
pulses.description: A critical vulnerability in Langflow, an open-source visual framework for AI agents and RAG pipelines, was disclosed on March 17, 2026. The vulnerability, CVE-2026-33017, allows unauthenticated remote code execution on exposed Langflow instances. Within 20 hours, exploitation attempts were observed in the wild. pulses.name: Copyright Lures Mask a Multi-Stage PureLog Stealer Attack on Key Industries
pulses.description: A sophisticated malware campaign delivering PureLog Stealer has been identified, targeting healthcare, government, hospitality, and education sectors in multiple countries. The attack uses localized copyright violation lures to trick victims into executing a multi-stage infection chain.
